_about: Binary interaction parameters k_ij (symmetric, k_ji = k_ij) for the Peng-Robinson and SRK equations of state with van der Waals one-fluid mixing rules. Pairs not listed use k_ij = 0, and the system reports them as such. Generated by validation/python/eos_kij_from_chemsep.py.

source.name: ChemSep interaction parameter files pr.ipd and srk.ipd (DECHEMA Peng-Robinson / Soave-Redlich-Kwong EOS data; library created by A. L. Dill 1996 and J. A. Clark 2014, updated by H. Kooijman)
source.license: Artistic License 2.0, Copyright Harry Kooijman and Ross Taylor
source.selection: Where the file lists several DECHEMA data sets for a pair (entries_in_file > 1; the others are in `alternatives`), CHEPTA uses the entry kept in the ChemSep pr.ipd copy distributed with the thermo library 0.6.1, and for SRK the entry from the same DECHEMA page. `printed` is the value as printed in the file; `conditions` is the file's comment (DECHEMA page, temperature and pressure range of the data).

source.fit: Fitted for CHEPTA with validation/python/eos_fit_kij.py to 29 bubble pressures: AAD 6.54 %, deviations -9.2 to 12.2 %

replaced.reason: The ChemSep PR value (-0.51) under-predicts the bubble pressure of the open data sets of Tsuji et al. (2005) and Aslam et al. (2016) by 66-78 % (k_ij = 0: 38-51 %), i.e. it predicts 3-4 times too much hydrogen solubility; the SRK value from the same DECHEMA page is +0.39. Found by the independent review of pull request #13.
